title: evid/1: the graph of the proofs of the candidate identities
description: Format «evid/1» (crates/mzlab-feat/src/evid.rs). `prova` is a proof record, identical to an entry of `evidence[]` of mzid/1. The points come from the table `punti` of livelli/1 (mzlab/web/livelli-1.js): the total orders the candidates and never assigns the level. A proof 'contro' has 0 points and is never offset by the points of another.

versione_punti.description: version of the table `punti` of livelli/1 used

valore.description: measured value (null when it could not be measured)

soglia.description: threshold of the step reached, or the lowest step when none is reached

fonte.description: module or tool that produced the proof (e.g. edge_evidence, mzlab-feat/kinetic)

codice.description: reason code of an automatic decision, e.g. EV_AGAINST_OPEN

contributi.description: the column of the contributions: always shown, one row per proof, in the order of `tipo`

totale.description: sum of the points of the proofs 'a favore'

contro.description: number of proofs 'contro'; with any, the identity goes after the others

n.description: candidates that the proofs cannot tell apart within the tolerances
